opening_message: My 18-month-old son has had a fever, vomiting, and diarrhea for the last two days.

disclosure_items.first_person_phrasing: He's had a mild fever for about two days.
He started vomiting two days ago as well.
He's been having diarrhea for the same two days.
We went to an urgent care clinic last night.
They told us to continue with acetaminophen and fluids.
He usually voids overnight, but he didn't last night.
I took his temperature this morning and it was 38.1 degrees Celsius.
He looks sick, but he's alert and making good eye contact.
I noticed his pulse is about 140.
His breathing seems a bit fast; I counted 32 breaths per minute.
